Rock Declutterer

Download Now

It's time to cleanup your rocks. Inspired by the popular Bubble Spinner game, but with rocks. I ran out of time to make music 😭

HBA!

Modes

  • classic: one board with every color, shots bounce off the side walls
  • modern: starts with 3 colors and every cleared board brings one more, up to 6, and adds 1 to the score multiplier. Shots bounce off every wall and are spent on their 6th bounce
  • versus: two players on one pad, online available on non-web builds as it's experimental now

Controls

Keyboard/Mouse:

  • mouse or arrows: aim, hold shift to turn slowly
    • Touch screen supported as well, trying to get this working everywhere!
  • click, x or space: fire
  • p: pause
  • escape: quit

Gamepad:

  • dpad or left stick: aim, hold the right trigger to turn slowly
  • a or x: fire
  • start: pause
  • hold select: menu, a quits, x toggles the fps counter

Versus

Versus is two players on one screen, a gun on each side of the screen:

The players sit at either end of the console facing each other, so the buttons are laid out for a screen seen from the side.

  • left player: dpad up and down swing the gun, right fires, left turns slowly
  • right player: the top and bottom face buttons swing the gun, the left one fires, the right one turns slowly
  • or the stick on your side aims, click it to fire

Bank a shot off the wall into the other gun to make it fire whatever it has loaded. A gun that was hit can't be set off again for 10 seconds.

  • keyboard: wasd and the arrows stand in for the two button diamondser
